steps.en: Review the license and copy the static collage skill into Codex
steps.zh: 核对许可，把静态拼贴技能放进 Codex

steps.en: Supply your photo and name the scene relationship to preserve
steps.zh: 提供自己的照片，说明要保留的现场关系

steps.en: Build a Scene Card and reduce detail to source-derived shapes
steps.zh: 建立场景卡，把细节压缩成源图形状

steps.en: Compile the prompt and generate with the photo as reference
steps.zh: 编译提示词，用照片作参考生成海报

steps.en: Inspect, correct at most once, and return the poster plus rationale
steps.zh: 看图，至多修一轮，交付海报与创作说明

value.en: A scene-specific paper collage without manually placing each illustration and color field
value.zh: 得到保留现场关系的纸感拼贴，不必逐块摆放插画与色场
